title: Ten

notes: Reverberant twin-guitar anthems balance soaring vocals with trauma, alienation and vulnerable ballads.

title: Vs.
sounds_like: Soundgarden|Neil Young & Crazy Horse|The Who|Red Hot Chili Peppers

title: Vitalogy
sounds_like: The Stooges|MC5|Tom Waits|Neil Young & Crazy Horse
notes: Ragged punk blasts, delicate ballads and abrasive studio collage resist fame and expectation.

title: No Code
sounds_like: Neil Young & Crazy Horse|The Who|R.E.M.|Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan
